grouping.name: Document Templates
grouping.description:
Document-level templates describe the purpose and rules for constructing a conforming CDA document. Document templates include constraints on the CDA header and indicate contained section-level templates.

Each document-level template contains the following information:
* Scope and intended use of the document type
* Description and explanatory narrative
* Template metadata (e.g., templateId)
* Header constraints (e.g., document type, template id, participants)
* Required and optional section-level templates

grouping.name: Section Templates
grouping.description:
This chapter contains the section-level templates referenced by one or more of the document types of this consolidated guide. These templates describe the purpose of each section and the section-level constraints.

Section-level templates are always included in a document. One and only one of each section type is allowed in a given document instance. Please see the document context tables to determine the sections that are contained in a given document type. Please see the conformance verb in the conformance statements to determine if it is required (SHALL), strongly recommended (SHOULD), or optional (MAY).

Each section-level template contains the following:
* Template metadata (e.g., templateId, etc.)
* Description and explanatory narrative
* LOINC section code
* Section title
* Requirements for a text element
* Entry-level template names and Ids for referenced templates (required and optional)

Narrative Text

The text element within the section stores the narrative to be rendered, as described in the CDA R2 specification, and is referred to as the CDA narrative block.

The content model of the CDA narrative block schema is handcrafted to meet requirements of human readability and rendering. The schema is registered as a MIME type (text/x-hl7-text+xml), which is the fixed media type for the text element.

As noted in the CDA R2 specification, the document originator is responsible for ensuring that the narrative block contains the complete, human readable, attested content of the section. Structured entries support computer processing and computation and are not a replacement for the attestable, human-readable content of the CDA narrative block. The special case of structured entries with an entry relationship of "DRIV" (is derived from) indicates to the receiving application that the source of the narrative block is the structured entries, and that the contents of the two are clinically equivalent.

For all CDA documents—even when a report consisting entirely of structured entries is transformed into CDA—the encoding application must ensure that the authenticated content (narrative plus multimedia) is a faithful and complete rendering of the clinical content of the structured source data. As a general guideline, a generated narrative block should include the same human readable content that would be available to users viewing that content in the originating system. Although content formatting in the narrative block need not be identical to that in the originating system, the narrative block should use elements from the CDA narrative block schema to provide sufficient formatting to support human readability when rendered according to the rules defined in Section Narrative Block (§ 4.3.5 ) of the CDA R2 specification.

By definition, a receiving application cannot assume that all clinical content in a section (i.e., in the narrative block and multimedia) is contained in the structured entries unless the entries in the section have an entry relationship of "DRIV".

Additional specification information for the CDA narrative block can be found in the CDA R2 specification in sections 1.2.1, 1.2.3, 1.3, 1.3.1, 1.3.2, 4.3.4.2, and 6.

grouping.name: Entry Templates
grouping.description:
This chapter describes the clinical statement entry templates used within the sections of the document types of this consolidated guide. Entry templates contain constraints that are required for conformance.

Entry-level templates are always in sections.

Each entry-level template description contains the following information:
* Key template metadata (e.g., template identifier, etc.)
* Description and explanatory narrative.
* Required CDA acts, participants and vocabularies.
* Optional CDA acts, participants and vocabularies.
Several entry-level templates require an effectiveTime:

The effectiveTime of an observation is the time interval over which the observation is known to be true. The low and high values should be as precise as possible, but no more precise than known. While CDA has multiple mechanisms to record this time interval (e.g., by low and high values, low and width, high and width, or center point and width), this guide constrains most to use only the low/high form. The low value is the earliest point for which the condition is known to have existed. The high value, when present, indicates the time at which the observation was no longer known to be true. The full description of effectiveTime and time intervals is contained in the CDA R2 normative edition.

Provenance in entry templates:

In this version of Consolidated CDA (C-CDA), we have added a "SHOULD" Author constraint on several entry-level templates. Authorship and Author timestamps must be explicitly asserted in these cases, unless the values propagated from the document header hold true.

ID in entry templates:

Entry-level templates may also describe an id element, which is an identifier for that entry. This id may be referenced within the document, or by the system receiving the document. The id assigned must be globally unique.

grouping.name: Participation & Other Templates
grouping.description: The participation and other templates chapter contains templates for CDA participations (e.g., author, performer), and other fielded items (e.g., address, name) that cannot stand on their own without being nested in another template.

grouping.name: Deprecated Templates
grouping.description: Deprecated templates are not prohibited from use, but their status as deprecated is a signal to implementers that the template may be permanently retired (terminated) in the future.

grouping.name: C-CDA Template Examples
grouping.description: These examples show how the C-CDA logical model templates are constructed.

grouping.name: C-CDA Internal Terminology
grouping.description: Code Systems and Value Sets that are defined in this guide.

resource.name: Care Plan
resource.description: A Care Plan is a consensus-driven dynamic plan that represents a patient's and Care Team Member's prioritized concerns, goals, and planned interventions.

resource.name: Consultation Note
resource.description: The Consultation Note is generated by a request from a clinician for an opinion or advice from another clinician.

resource.name: Continuity of Care Document (CCD)
resource.description: The Continuity of Care Document (CCD) represents a core data set of the most relevant administrative, demographic, and clinical information facts about a patient's healthcare, covering one or more healthcare encounters.

resource.name: Discharge Summary
resource.description: The Discharge Summary is a document which synopsizes a patient's admission to a hospital, LTPAC provider, or other setting.

resource.name: History and Physical
resource.description: A History and Physical (H&P) note is a medical report that documents the current and past conditions of the patient.

resource.name: Operative Note
resource.description: The Operative Note is a frequently used type of procedure note with specific requirements set forth by regulatory agencies.

resource.name: Procedure Note
resource.description: A Procedure Note encompasses many types of non-operative procedures including interventional cardiology, gastrointestinal endoscopy, osteopathic manipulation, and many other specialty fields.

resource.name: Progress Note
resource.description: This template represents a patient's clinical status during a hospitalization, outpatient visit, treatment with a LTPAC provider, or other healthcare encounter.

resource.name: Referral Note
resource.description: A Referral Note communicates pertinent information from a provider who is requesting services of another provider of clinical or non-clinical services.

resource.name: Transfer Summary
resource.description: The Transfer Summary standardizes critical information for exchange of information between providers of care when a patient moves between health care settings.

resource.name: Unstructured Document
resource.description: An Unstructured Document (UD) document type can (1) include unstructured content, such as a graphic, directly in a text element with a mediaType attribute, or (2) reference a single document file, such as a word-processing document using a text/reference element.

resource.name: US Realm Header
resource.description: This template defines constraints that represent common administrative and demographic concepts for US Realm CDA documents.

reference.display: US Realm Header for Patient Generated Document

resource.name: US Realm Header for Patient Generated Document
resource.description: This template focuses on the patient or related person in the roles of author and other participants and is designed to be used in conjunction with the US Realm Header.

resource.name: Activities Section
resource.description: This template represents Activities.

resource.name: Admission Diagnosis Section
resource.description: This section contains a narrative description of the problems or diagnoses identified by the clinician at the time of the patient's admission.

resource.name: Admission Medications Section (entries optional)
resource.description: The section contains the medications taken by the patient prior to and at the time of admission to the facility.

resource.name: Advance Directives Section
resource.description: This section contains information describing the patient’s advance healthcare directives.

resource.name: Allergies and Intolerances Section
resource.description: This section lists and describes any medication allergies, adverse reactions, idiosyncratic reactions, anaphylaxis/anaphylactoid reactions to food items, and metabolic variations or adverse reactions/allergies to other substances (such as latex, iodine, tape adhesives).

resource.name: Anesthesia Section
resource.description: The Anesthesia Section records the type of anesthesia (e.g., general or local) and may state the actual agent used.

resource.name: Assessment and Plan Section
resource.description: This section represents the clinician's conclusions and working assumptions that will guide treatment of the patient.

resource.name: Assessment Section
resource.description: The Assessment Section (also referred to as "impression" or "diagnoses" outside of the context of CDA) represents the clinician's conclusions and working assumptions that will guide treatment of the patient.

resource.name: Care Teams Section
resource.description: The Care Teams Section is used to share historical and current Care Team information.

reference.display: Chief Complaint and Reason for Visit Section

resource.name: Chief Complaint and Reason for Visit Section
resource.description: This section records the patient's chief complaint (the patient's own description) and/or the reason for the patient's visit (the provider's description of the reason for visit).

resource.name: Chief Complaint Section
resource.description: This section records the patient's chief complaint (the patient's own description).

resource.name: Complications Section
resource.description: This section contains problems that occurred during or around the time of a procedure.

resource.name: Course of Care Section
resource.description: The Course of Care section describes what happened during the course of an encounter.

resource.name: Discharge Diagnosis Section
resource.description: This template represents problems or diagnoses present at the time of discharge which occurred during the hospitalization.

resource.name: Discharge Medications Section
resource.description: This section contains the medications the patient is intended to take or stop after discharge.

resource.name: Encounters Section
resource.description: This section lists and describes any healthcare encounters pertinent to the patient's current health status or historical health history.

resource.name: Family History Section
resource.description: This section contains data defining the patient's genetic relatives in terms of possible or relevant health risk factors that have a potential impact on the patient's healthcare risk profile.

resource.name: Functional Status Section
resource.description: The Functional Status Section contains observations and assessments of a patient's physical abilities.

resource.name: General Status Section
resource.description: The General Status section describes general observations and readily observable attributes of the patient, including affect and demeanor, apparent age compared to actual age, gender, ethnicity, nutritional status based on appearance, body build and habitus (e.g., muscular, cachectic, obese), developmental or other deformities, gait and mobility, personal hygiene, evidence of distress, and voice quality and speech.

resource.name: Goals Section
resource.description: This template represents patient Goals.

resource.name: Health Concerns Section
resource.description: This section contains data describing an interest or worry about a health state or process that could possibly require attention, intervention, or management.

reference.display: Health Status Evaluations and Outcomes Section

resource.name: Health Status Evaluations and Outcomes Section
resource.description: This section represents observations regarding the evaluation or assessment of the patient, and the outcome of care from the interventions used to treat the patient.

resource.name: History of Present Illness Section
resource.description: The History of Present Illness section describes the history related to the reason for the encounter.

resource.name: Hospital Consultations Section
resource.description: The Hospital Consultations Section records consultations that occurred during the admission.

resource.name: Hospital Course Section
resource.description: The Hospital Course Section describes the sequence of events from admission to discharge in a hospital facility.

resource.name: Hospital Discharge Instructions Section
resource.description: The Hospital Discharge Instructions Section records instructions at discharge.

resource.name: Hospital Discharge Physical Section
resource.description: The Hospital Discharge Physical Section records a narrative description of the patient's physical findings.

resource.name: Hospital Discharge Studies Summary Section
resource.description: This section records the results of observations generated by laboratories, imaging procedures, and other procedures.

resource.name: Immunizations Section
resource.description: The Immunizations Section defines a patient's current immunization status and pertinent immunization history.

resource.name: Instructions Section
resource.description: The Instructions Section records instructions given to a patient.

resource.name: Medical (General) History Section
resource.description: The Medical History Section describes all aspects of the medical history of the patient even if not pertinent to the current procedure, and may include chief complaint, past medical history, social history, family history, surgical or procedure history, medication history, and other history information.

resource.name: Medical Equipment Section
resource.description: This section defines a patient's implanted and external health and medical devices and equipment.

resource.name: Medications Administered Section
resource.description: The Medications Administered Section usually resides inside a Procedure Note describing a procedure.

resource.name: Medications Section
resource.description: The Medications Section contains a patient's current medications and pertinent medication history.

resource.name: Mental Status Section
resource.description: The Mental Status Section contains observations and evaluations related to a patient's psychological and mental competency and deficits.

resource.name: Notes Section
resource.description: The Notes Section allow for inclusion of clinical documentation which does not fit precisely within any other C-CDA section.

resource.name: Nutrition Section
resource.description: The Nutrition Section represents diet and nutrition information including special diet requirements and restrictions (e.g., texture modified diet, liquids only, enteral feeding).

resource.name: Objective Section
resource.description: The Objective Section contains data about the patient gathered through tests, measures, or observations that produce a quantified or categorized result.

resource.name: Operative Note Fluids Section
resource.description: The Operative Note Fluids Section may be used to record fluids administered during the surgical procedure.

resource.name: Operative Note Surgical Procedure Section
resource.description: The Operative Note Surgical Procedure Section can be used to restate the procedures performed if appropriate for an enterprise workflow.

resource.name: Past Medical History
resource.description: This section contains a record of the patient's past complaints, problems, and diagnoses.

resource.name: Payers Section
resource.description: The Payers Section contains data on the patient's payers, whether "third party" insurance, self-pay, other payer or guarantor, or some combination of payers, and is used to define which entity is the responsible fiduciary for the financial aspects of a patient's care.

resource.name: Physical Exam Section
resource.description: The section includes direct observations made by a clinician.

resource.name: Plan of Treatment Section
resource.description: This section, formerly known as "Plan of Care", contains data that define pending orders, interventions, encounters, services, and procedures for the patient.

resource.name: Planned Procedure Section
resource.description: This section contains the procedure(s) that a clinician planned based on the preoperative assessment.

resource.name: Postoperative Diagnosis Section
resource.description: The Postoperative Diagnosis Section records the diagnosis or diagnoses discovered or confirmed during the surgery.

resource.name: Postprocedure Diagnosis Section
resource.description: The Postprocedure Diagnosis Section records the diagnosis or diagnoses discovered or confirmed during the procedure.

resource.name: Preoperative Diagnosis Section
resource.description: The Preoperative Diagnosis Section records the surgical diagnoses assigned to the patient before the surgical procedure which are the reason for the surgery.

resource.name: Problem Section
resource.description: This section lists and describes all relevant clinical problems at the time the document is generated.

resource.name: Procedure Description Section
resource.description: The Procedure Description section records the particulars of the procedure and may include procedure site preparation, surgical site preparation, pertinent details related to sedation/anesthesia, pertinent details related to measurements and markings, procedure times, medications administered, estimated blood loss, specimens removed, implants, instrumentation, sponge counts, tissue manipulation, wound closure, sutures used, vital signs and other monitoring data.

resource.name: Procedure Disposition Section
resource.description: The Procedure Disposition Section records the status and condition of the patient at the completion of the procedure or surgery.

resource.name: Procedure Estimated Blood Loss Section
resource.description: The Procedure Estimated Blood Loss Section may be a subsection of another section such as the Procedure Description Section.

resource.name: Procedure Findings Section
resource.description: The Procedure Findings Section records clinically significant observations confirmed or discovered during a procedure or surgery.

resource.name: Procedure Implants Section
resource.description: The Procedure Implants Section records any materials placed during the procedure including stents, tubes, and drains.

resource.name: Procedure Indications Section
resource.description: This section contains the reason(s) for the procedure or surgery.

resource.name: Procedure Specimens Taken Section
resource.description: The Procedure Specimens Taken Section records the tissues, objects, or samples taken from the patient during the procedure including biopsies, aspiration fluid, or other samples sent for pathological analysis.

resource.name: Procedures Section
resource.description: This section describes all historical or current interventional, surgical, diagnostic, or therapeutic procedures or treatments pertinent to the patient at the time the document is generated.

resource.name: Reason for Referral Section
resource.description: This section describes the clinical reason why a provider is sending a patient to another provider for care.

resource.name: Reason for Visit Section
resource.description: This section records the patient's reason for the patient's visit (as documented by the provider).

resource.name: Results Section
resource.description: The Results Section contains observations of results generated by laboratories, imaging procedures, and other procedures.

resource.name: Review of Systems Section
resource.description: The Review of Systems Section contains a relevant collection of symptoms and functions systematically gathered by a clinician.

resource.name: Social History Section
resource.description: This section contains social history data that influence a patient's physical, psychological or emotional health (e.g., smoking status, pregnancy).

resource.name: Subjective Section
resource.description: The Subjective Section describes in a narrative format the patient's current condition and/or interval changes as reported by the patient or by the patient's guardian or another informant.

resource.name: Surgical Drains Section
resource.description: The Surgical Drains Section may be used to record drains placed during the surgical procedure.

resource.name: Vital Signs Section
resource.description: The Vital Signs Section contains relevant vital signs for the context and use case of the document type, such as blood pressure (including average blood pressure), heart rate, respiratory rate, height, weight, body mass index, head circumference, pulse oximetry, temperature, and body surface area.

resource.name: Admission Medication
resource.description: This template represents the medications taken by the patient prior to and at the time of admission.

resource.name: Advance Directive Observation
resource.description: Advance Directive Observations may include a variety of information called different “content types”.

resource.name: Advance Directive Organizer
resource.description: The Advance Directive Organizer includes information about who verified the content available in each advance healthcare directive source document or other verified source documentation.

resource.name: Age Observation
resource.description: This Age Observation represents the subject's age at onset of an event or observation.

resource.name: Allergy - Intolerance Observation
resource.description: This template reflects a discrete observation about a patient's allergy or intolerance.

resource.name: Allergy Concern Act
resource.description: This template reflects an ongoing concern on behalf of the provider that placed the allergy on a patient's allergy list.

resource.name: Allergy Status Observation
resource.description: This template represents the clinical status attributed to the allergy or intolerance.

resource.name: Assessment Scale Observation
resource.description: An assessment scale is a collection of observations that together can yield a calculated or non-calculated summary evaluation of a one or more conditions.

resource.name: Assessment Scale Supporting Observation
resource.description: An Assessment Scale Supporting Observation represents the components of a scale used in an Assessment Scale Observation.

resource.name: Authorization Activity
resource.description: An Authorization Activity represents authorizations or pre-authorizations currently active for the patient for the particular payer.

resource.name: Average Blood Pressure Organizer
resource.description: This template represents a single instance of an Average Blood Pressure reading.

resource.name: Basic Industry Observation
resource.description: This template represents a simple observation about the type of business that compensates for work or assigns work to an unpaid worker or volunteer (e.g., US Army, cement manufacturing, children and youth services).

resource.name: Basic Occupation Observation
resource.description: This template represents a simple observation about the type of work (e.g., infantry, business analyst, social worker) of a person.

resource.name: Birth Sex Observation
resource.description: This observation represents the sex of the patient at birth.

resource.name: Brand Name Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Brand Name.

resource.name: Care Experience Preference
resource.description: This Care Experience Preference template represents a person's care preferences for their care and treatment.

resource.name: Care Team Member Act
resource.description: This template is used to represent a member of the care team.

resource.name: Care Team Member Schedule Observation
resource.description: This template represents the schedule of when the care team member participates on the care team.

resource.name: Care Team Organizer
resource.description: This organizer template contains information about a single care team.

resource.name: Care Team Type Observation
resource.description: This template is used to express the care team type.

resource.name: Caregiver Characteristics
resource.description: This clinical statement represents a caregiver's willingness to provide care and the abilities of that caregiver to provide assistance to a patient in relation to a specific need.

resource.name: Catalog Number Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Catalog Number.

resource.name: Characteristics of Home Environment
resource.description: This template represents the patient's home environment including, but not limited to, type of residence (trailer, single family home, assisted living), living arrangement (e.g., alone, with parents), and housing status (e.g., evicted, homeless, home owner).

resource.name: Comment Activity
resource.description: Comments are free text data that cannot otherwise be recorded using data elements already defined by this specification.

resource.name: Company Name Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Company Name.

resource.name: Coverage Activity
resource.description: A Coverage Activity groups the policy and authorization acts within a Payers Section to order the payment sources.

resource.name: Criticality Observation
resource.description: This observation represents the gravity of the potential risk for future life-threatening adverse reactions when exposed to a substance known to cause an adverse reaction in that individual.

resource.name: Cultural and Religious Observation
resource.description: This template represents a patient's spiritual, religious, and cultural belief practices, such as a kosher diet or fasting ritual.

resource.name: Date of Diagnosis Act
resource.description: This template represents the earliest date of diagnosis, which is the date of first determination by a qualified professional of the presence of a problem or condition affecting a patient.

resource.name: Deceased Observation
resource.description: This template represents the observation that a patient has died.

resource.name: Device Identifier Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Device Identifier (also known as the "Primary DI Number") for a medical device marketed in the US.

resource.name: Disability Status Observation
resource.description: This template represents an assessment of patients perception of their physical, cognitive, intellectual, or psychiatric disabilities.

resource.name: Discharge Medication
resource.description: This template represents medications that the patient is intended to take (or stop) after discharge.

resource.name: Distinct Identification Code Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Distinct Identification Code for an HCT/P product regulated as a device as cited in 21 CFR 1271.290(c).

resource.name: Drug Monitoring Act
resource.description: This template represents the act of monitoring the patient's medication and includes a participation to record the person responsible for monitoring the medication.

resource.name: Drug Vehicle
resource.description: This template represents the vehicle (e.g., saline, dextrose) for administering a medication.

resource.name: Encounter Activity
resource.description: This clinical statement describes an interaction between a patient and clinician.

resource.name: Encounter Diagnosis
resource.description: This template wraps relevant problems or diagnoses at the close of a visit or that need to be followed after the visit.

resource.name: Entry Reference
resource.description: This template represents the act of referencing another entry in the same CDA document instance.

resource.name: Estimated Date of Delivery
resource.description: This clinical statement represents the anticipated date when a woman will give birth.

resource.name: Expiration Date Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Expiration Date of the device.

resource.name: External Document Reference
resource.description: Where it is necessary to reference an external clinical document, the External Document Reference template can be used to reference this external document.

resource.name: Family History Death Observation
resource.description: This clinical statement records whether the family member is deceased.

resource.name: Family History Observation
resource.description: Family History Observations related to a particular family member are contained within a Family History Organizer.

resource.name: Family History Organizer
resource.description: The Family History Organizer associates a set of observations with a family member.

resource.name: Functional Status Observation
resource.description: This template represents the patient's physical function (e.g., mobility status, instrumental activities of daily living, self-care status) and problems that limit function (dyspnea, dysphagia).

resource.name: Functional Status Organizer
resource.description: This template groups related functional status observations into categories (e.g., mobility, self-care).

resource.name: Gender Identity Observation
resource.description: This observation represents the gender identity of the patient.

resource.name: Goal Observation
resource.description: This template represents a patient health goal.

resource.name: Handoff Communication Participants
resource.description: This template represents the sender (author) and receivers (participants) of a handoff communication in a plan of treatment.

resource.name: Health Concern Act
resource.description: This template represents a health concern.

resource.name: Health Status Observation
resource.description: This template represents information about the overall health status of the patient.

resource.name: Highest Pressure Ulcer Stage
resource.description: This observation contains a description of the wound tissue of the most severe or highest staged pressure ulcer observed on a patient.

resource.name: Hospital Admission Diagnosis
resource.description: This template represents problems or diagnoses identified by the clinician at the time of the patient's admission.

resource.name: Hospital Discharge Diagnosis
resource.description: This template represents problems or diagnoses present at the time of discharge which occurred during the hospitalization or need to be monitored after hospitalization.

resource.name: Immunization Activity
resource.description: An Immunization Activity describes immunization substance administrations that have actually occurred or are intended to occur.

resource.name: Immunization Medication Information
resource.description: The Immunization Medication Information represents product information about the immunization substance.

resource.name: Immunization Not Given Reason
resource.description: The Immunization Not Given Reason documents the rationale for the patient declining an immunization.

resource.name: Implantable Device Status Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to augment the parsed data from the a Unique Device Identifier (UDI).

resource.name: Indication
resource.description: This template represents the rationale for an action such as an encounter, a medication administration, or a procedure.

resource.name: Instruction
resource.description: The Instruction template can be used in several ways, such as to record patient instructions within a Medication Activity or to record fill instructions within a supply order.

resource.name: Intervention Act
resource.description: This template represents an Intervention Act.

resource.name: Latex Safety Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Latex Safety Status of the patient's medical device.

resource.name: Longitudinal Care Wound Observation
resource.description: This template represents acquired or surgical wounds and is not intended to encompass all wound types.

resource.name: Lot or Batch Number Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Lot or Batch Number of the device.

resource.name: Manufacturing Date Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Manufacturing Date of the device.

resource.name: Medical Equipment Organizer
resource.description: This template represents a set of current or historical medical devices, supplies, aids and equipment used by the patient.

resource.name: Medication Activity
resource.description: A Medication Activity describes substance administrations that have actually occurred (e.g., pills ingested or injections given) or are intended to occur (e.g., "take 2 tablets twice a day for the next 10 days").

resource.name: Medication Adherence
resource.description: This profile represents whether a medication has been consumed according to instructions.

resource.name: Medication Dispense
resource.description: This template records the act of supplying medications (i.e., dispensing).

resource.name: Medication Free Text Sig
resource.description: The template is available to explicitly identify the free text Sig within each medication.

resource.name: Medication Information
resource.description: A medication should be recorded as a pre-coordinated ingredient + strength + dose form (e.g., "metoprolol 25mg tablet", "amoxicillin 400mg/5mL suspension") where possible.

resource.name: Medication Supply Order
resource.description: This template records the intent to supply a patient with medications.

resource.name: Mental Status Observation
resource.description: The Mental Status Observation template represents an observation about mental status that can come from a broad range of subjective and objective information (including measured data) to address those categories described in the Mental Status Section.

resource.name: Mental Status Organizer
resource.description: The Mental Status Organizer template may be used to group related Mental Status Observations (e.g., results of mental tests) and associated Assessment Scale Observations into subcategories and/or groupings by time.

resource.name: Model Number Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Model Number associated with the device.

resource.name: MRI Safety Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the MRI Safety Status of the patient's medical device.

resource.name: Non-Medicinal Supply Activity
resource.description: This template represents equipment supplied to the patient (e.g., pumps, inhalers, wheelchairs).

resource.name: Note Activity
resource.description: The Note Activity represents a clinical note.

resource.name: Number of Pressure Ulcers Observation
resource.description: This template represents the number of pressure ulcers observed at a particular stage.

resource.name: Nutrition Assessment
resource.description: This template represents the patient's nutrition abilities and habits including intake, diet requirements or diet followed.

resource.name: Nutrition Recommendation
resource.description: This template represents nutrition regimens (e.g., fluid restrictions, calorie minimum), interventions (e.g., NPO, nutritional supplements), and procedures (e.g., G-Tube by bolus, TPN by central line).

resource.name: Nutritional Status Observation
resource.description: This template describes the overall nutritional status of the patient including findings related to nutritional status.

resource.name: Outcome Observation
resource.description: This template represents the outcome of care resulting from the interventions used to treat the patient.

resource.name: Patient Referral Act
resource.description: This template represents the type of referral (e.g., for dental care, to a specialist, for aging problems) and represents whether the referral is for full care or shared care.

resource.name: Planned Coverage
resource.description: This template represents the insurance coverage intended to cover an act or procedure.

resource.name: Planned Encounter
resource.description: This template represents a planned or ordered encounter.

resource.name: Planned Immunization Activity
resource.description: This template represents planned immunizations.

resource.name: Planned Intervention Act
resource.description: This template represents a Planned Intervention Act.

resource.name: Planned Medication Activity
resource.description: This template represents planned medication activities.

resource.name: Planned Procedure
resource.description: This template represents planned alterations of the patient's physical condition.

resource.name: Planned Supply
resource.description: This template represents both medicinal and non-medicinal supplies ordered, requested, or intended for the patient (e.g., medication prescription, order for wheelchair).

resource.name: Policy Activity
resource.description: A policy activity represents the policy or program providing the coverage.

resource.name: Postprocedure Diagnosis
resource.description: This template represents the diagnosis or diagnoses discovered or confirmed during the procedure.

resource.name: Precondition for Substance Administration
resource.description: A criterion for administration can be used to record that the medication is to be administered only when the associated criteria are met.

resource.name: Pregnancy Intention in Next Year
resource.description: This template represents a patient's reported intention or desire in the next year to either become pregnant or prevent a future pregnancy.

resource.name: Pregnancy Observation
resource.description: This clinical statement represents current and/or prior pregnancy dates enabling investigators to determine if the subject of the case report was pregnant during the course of a condition.

resource.name: Preoperative Diagnosis
resource.description: This template represents the surgical diagnosis or diagnoses assigned to the patient before the surgical procedure and is the reason for the surgery.

resource.name: Priority Preference
resource.description: This template represents priority preferences chosen by a patient or a care provider.

resource.name: Problem Concern Act
resource.description: This template reflects an ongoing concern on behalf of the provider that placed the concern on a patient's problem list.

resource.name: Problem Observation
resource.description: This template reflects a discrete observation about a patient's problem.

resource.name: Problem Status
resource.description: The Problem Status records the clinical status attributed to the problem.

resource.name: Procedure Activity Procedure
resource.description: This template is used to represent the details of current and historical procedures performed on or for a patient.

resource.name: Product Instance
resource.description: This clinical statement represents a particular device that was placed in a patient or used as part of a procedure or other act.

resource.name: Prognosis Observation
resource.description: This template represents the patient's prognosis, which must be associated with a problem observation.

resource.name: Progress Toward Goal Observation
resource.description: This template represents a patient's progress toward a goal.

resource.name: Reaction Observation
resource.description: This clinical statement represents the response to an undesired symptom, finding, etc.

resource.name: Reason
resource.description: This template describes the thought process or justification for an action or for not performing an action.

resource.name: Result Observation
resource.description: This template represents the results of a laboratory, radiology, or other study performed on a patient.

resource.name: Result Organizer
resource.description: This template provides a mechanism for grouping result observations.

resource.name: Risk Concern Act
resource.description: This template represents a risk concern.

resource.name: Section Time Range Observation
resource.description: This observation represents the date and time range of the information contained in a section.

resource.name: Self-Care Activities (ADL and IADL)
resource.description: This template represents a patient's daily self-care ability.

resource.name: Sensory Status
resource.description: This template represents a patient's sensory or speech ability.

resource.name: Serial Number Observation
resource.description: This template is intended to be used in addition to the Product Instance template to exchange the Serial Number of the device.

resource.name: Service Delivery Location
resource.description: This clinical statement represents the physical place of available services or resources.

resource.name: Severity Observation
resource.description: This clinical statement represents the gravity of the problem, such as allergy or reaction, in terms of its actual or potential impact on the patient.

resource.name: Sex Observation
resource.description: This Sex Observation template is used to reflect the documentation of a person's sex.

resource.name: Sexual Orientation Observation
resource.description: This observation represents the sexual orientation of the patient.

resource.name: Smoking Status
resource.description: This template represents a patient's smoking status.

resource.name: Social History Observation
resource.description: This template represents a patient's job (occupation and industry), lifestyle, and environmental health risk factors.

resource.name: Specimen Collection Procedure
resource.description: This template represents clinical information about the specimen including when it was collected, the type and source of specimen, as well as related observations regarding the specimen.

resource.name: Specimen Condition Observation
resource.description: This template conveys the condition (mode or state of being) that describes the nature of the specimen.

resource.name: Substance Administered Act
resource.description: This template represents the administration course in a series.

reference.display: Substance or Device Allergy - Intolerance Observation

resource.name: Substance or Device Allergy - Intolerance Observation
resource.description: This template reflects a discrete observation about a patient's allergy or intolerance to a substance or device.

resource.name: Treatment Intervention Preference
resource.description: This Treatment Intervention Preference template represents personal health goals, preferences, and priorities for medical treatments or interventions in the event of a future health scenario where a person is unable to make medical decisions because of a serious illness or injury.

resource.name: Tribal Affiliation Observation
resource.description: This template represents the tribe or band that an individual associates with, within the United States.

resource.name: UDI Organizer
resource.description: This template is nested in an entryRelationship/Procedure Activity Procedure to record all the UDI-related templates to exchange the parsed UDI data elements and associated data.

resource.name: Vital Sign Observation
resource.description: This template represents measurement of common vital signs.

resource.name: Vital Signs Organizer
resource.description: This template provides a mechanism for grouping vital signs (e.g., grouping systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure).

resource.name: Wound Characteristic
resource.description: This template represents characteristics of a wound (e.g., integrity of suture line, odor, erythema).

resource.name: Wound Measurement Observation
resource.description: This template represents the Wound Measurement Observations of wound width, depth and length.

resource.name: Author Participation
resource.description: This template represents the Author Participation (including the author timestamp).

resource.name: Provenance - Assembler Participation
resource.description: This template represents the organization that supported generation of a CDA document.

resource.name: Provenance - Author Participation
resource.description: This template represents the key information to record Provenance in an Author Participation.

reference.display: Related Person Relationship and Name Participant

resource.name: Related Person Relationship and Name Participant
resource.description: This template represents a generic participant person that has a relationship to the patient.

resource.name: US Realm Address
resource.description: Reusable address template, for use in US Realm documents.

resource.name: US Realm Date and Time - Interval
resource.description: The US Realm Clinical Document Date and Time datatype flavor records date and time information.

reference.display: US Realm Date and Time (Point in Time)

resource.name: US Realm Date and Time - Point in Time
resource.description: The US Realm Clinical Document Date and Time datatype flavor records date and time information.

resource.name: US Realm Patient Name (PTN.US.FIELDED)
resource.description: The US Realm Patient Name datatype flavor is a set of reusable constraints that can be used for the patient or any other person.

resource.name: US Realm Person Name (PN.US.FIELDED)
resource.description: The US Realm Clinical Document Person Name datatype flavor is a set of reusable constraints that can be used for Persons.

resource.name: Smoking Status - Meaningful Use
resource.description: This template represents the current smoking status of the patient as specified in Meaningful Use (MU) Stage 2 requirements.

resource.name: Tobacco Use
resource.description: This template represents a patient's tobacco use.
